cohort: The study included 354 pregnant women in the perinatal period admitted to Muhimbili National Hospital.
finding: The overall proportion of PUI among participants was 16.7%, significantly associated with normal BMI, pre-obesity, grand multiparity, and a previous history of cesarean section, with a moderate to poor impact on quality of life.
mod_finding: A previous history of cesarean section was significantly associated with perinatal urinary incontinence.
